title: Viatsy
description: Search Asia travel tours, browse guides, request quotes, find upcoming group departures.
summary: Search Asia travel tours, browse guides, request quotes, find upcoming group departures.
offersHint: Search Asia travel tours, browse guides, request quotes, find upcoming group departures. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://viatsy.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_trips
toolsPreview.description: Search published tours. Filter by destination slug, free-text search, duration, or price.

toolsPreview.name: list_destinations
toolsPreview.description: List all published destinations this agency operates in (countries and sub-destinations).

toolsPreview.name: get_trip_details
toolsPreview.description: Get full trip details: description, duration, highlights, what is included/excluded, and a short itinerary summary. Use when the user asks about a specific trip.

toolsPreview.name: list_blog_articles
toolsPreview.description: Browse travel guides and articles. Returns published blog posts.

toolsPreview.name: list_upcoming_departures
toolsPreview.description: Find open group-trip departures with future dates. Filter by destination slug, date range, or max price. Use when the user asks "when can I go to X?" or wants to compare dates.

toolsPreview.name: request_quote
toolsPreview.description: Submit a quote request (inquiry) for a trip. Only use after the user has clearly asked for a quote and provided their name and email.

toolsPreview.name: subscribe_newsletter
toolsPreview.description: Subscribe the user to the travel newsletter. Sends a confirmation email — the subscription activates only after the user clicks the link.

toolsPreview.name: start_checkout
toolsPreview.description: Create a booking and get a secure payment link the customer opens to pay — card details never pass through you. Provide departureId for a group departure, or tripSlug + startDate for a private trip, plus the lead traveller name, email and traveller counts. Returns a bookingReference and paymentUrl; hand the paymentUrl to the customer to complete payment. Quote prices beforehand via get_trip_details or list_upcoming_departures — the payment page shows the authoritative total.
